method:
Independent native and actual-room checks for the Emerald-inspired canopy.

Reuses the established 4bpp/ELF readers, not the asset packer. The direct new
painters are read in an isolated subprocess. Aesthetic approval is separate:
leaf-volume and blending must be judged in native actual-room pictures.

visibility.criterion: native source counts plus independent four-connected component and minimal-row proof; actual framebuffer visibility checked separately

OBJ_superset.limits: Static allocation superset, not an OAM peak/CPU guarantee. Includes every enemy family although ordinary themed rooms use subsets. Portrait/HUD use their fixed higher reservations.

leaf_diagnostics.verdict: No aesthetic verdict. Review actual native rooms; these measurements distinguish content/flat regions but do not prove leaf volume.

source_gallery.limits: Source file/native panels verified. These are not actual room framebuffers.

candidate.note: Counters read after each real mGBA video frame. Recorded gameplay cadence only; these are not CPU-cycle benchmarks or a universal performance guarantee.

baseline.note: Counters read after each real mGBA video frame. Recorded gameplay cadence only; these are not CPU-cycle benchmarks or a universal performance guarantee.

menu_timing_observations.note: Menu handoff timing is measured separately from ordinary PLAY cadence, not silently declared identical.

runtime.limits: Finite natural-room and ordinary-input observations; menu handoff timings are explicit observations; no universal animation/frame-time claim.
